bundle.shortDescription: Unofficial WhatsApp client for macOS, written in Rust
bundle.longDescription: RustWA is an unofficial, from-scratch WhatsApp client for macOS written in Rust. It reproduces the familiar WhatsApp layout while using a fraction of the resources of the official Catalyst app.
